items.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code's auto mode on by default
items.why_it_matters: Anthropic updated Claude Code to run in auto mode by default, meaning it will execute multi-step commands without asking for permission at every single step. This dramatically speeds up your vibe-coding loop, but increases the risk of runaway commands. To try this today, run `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest` to update your CLI, and run a multi-step refactor on your AI-ingest project using the new default auto mode.

items.title: Show HN: Whetstone – 20 Claude Code skills, each distilled from one real failure
items.why_it_matters: A developer released Whetstone, a collection of 20 custom system prompts and skills for Claude Code distilled from real-world failures. This gives you battle-tested guardrails to prevent your AI coder from hallucinating or breaking your Next.js and Supabase setup. This week, copy their custom Next.js or Supabase prompt template and add it to your local Claude Code configuration to improve your code generation accuracy.

items.title: Lessons from Reducing My Coding Agent's LLM API Costs
items.why_it_matters: A developer shared a practical breakdown of how they cut their coding agent's LLM API costs, which is highly relevant to your AI-ingest project and your interest in cost-saving strategies. Managing API costs is crucial as you scale your own tools or run heavy agent tasks. This week, read the cost-reduction strategies and implement a simple token-saving caching layer or model-routing logic in your Next.js AI-ingest backend.

items.title: Real-time MCP interceptor that blocks .env reads and dangerous commands agents
items.why_it_matters: This real-time MCP interceptor blocks AI agents from reading sensitive `.env` files or running dangerous commands on your machine. Since you use Claude Code (which supports MCP), protecting your local Supabase API keys and environment variables is a major security priority. This week, clone this MCP interceptor and add it to your Claude Code configuration to block unauthorized access to your local env keys.

items.title: Safe-rm: Remap `rm` on Macs to `mv _ Trash` so LLMs don't delete data
items.why_it_matters: This utility remaps the `rm` command on macOS to move files to the Trash instead of permanently deleting them, preventing AI agents from accidentally wiping your codebase. Since you use Claude Code in auto mode, a single hallucinated command could delete your project. Install this gist on your Mac today to safeguard your AI-ingest repository while vibe-coding.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source, searchable HTML workspace for Claude Code
items.why_it_matters: This open-source tool creates a searchable, visual HTML workspace for Claude Code outputs, making it easier to track what the AI is doing across your codebase. It helps you manage the 'direction' part of vibe coding by giving you a clear UI of the AI's changes. Spin up this workspace locally and point it at your AI-ingest directory to visualize your next feature build.
